name: Morse.hessianM
why: The project differentiates f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) p).symm twice at extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) p p; for the model 𝓘(ℝ, E) the extended chart is the preferred chart chartAt E p (project lemmas extChartAt_self_coe(_symm)), which is exactly the blind choice. Equal at every point, critical or not.
